slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is each product processed on all three machines in the fixed order Machine 1 → Machine 2 → Machine 3 (a flow shop), or can a product visit the machines in any order?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether products follow a fixed machine order, directly covering the sequential machine order constraint.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: By "total processing cycle for the three products," do you mean the sum of each product's completion time (i.e., the time at which each product finishes on Machine 3, added across the three products), or the time at which all three products have finished (the makespan)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for clarification of 'total processing cycle' and whether it means makespan, fully covering the objective ambiguity.
